properties.name: Meridian Fund IV
properties.strategy: Minority and structured-control investments in high-growth, profitable-at-scale software and technology-enabled services businesses
properties.target_sector: Technology — enterprise & vertical software, cloud infrastructure, applied AI/ML tooling
properties.return_target: Target net IRR: 18%–22%, Target net MOIC: 2.3x–2.8x
properties.investment_thesis: Category-leading software and IT services businesses with product-market fit, durable unit economics, and exposure to enterprise adoption of cloud, data, and applied-AI infrastructure
properties.exclusions: Jurisdictions subject to OFAC sanctions or FATF high-risk designation
properties.mandate_notes: Binding operating framework for sourcing, diligence, structuring, monitoring, and exit

investment_criteria.description: ESG diligence workstream with annual rating from 1–5 at entry and reassessment annually.
Customer concentration review including largest customer, top-ten exposure, renewal timing, and contractual protections.
Leverage and liquidity review including debt structure, cash availability, interest coverage, and downside liquidity.
Technology review including cloud dependency, architecture, cybersecurity, model-provider concentration, and resilience.
Regulatory review including securities law, sanctions, AML, privacy, and emerging AI-governance requirements.
Management review including key-person dependence, succession, and incentive alignment.
ESG diligence including environmental, social, and governance factors.

properties.decision_framework: Integrated risk review during underwriting; material risks assessed for probability, impact, mitigants, ownership, and monitoring cadence.

evidence.quote: Meridian Fund IV, L.P. is a growth-equity vehicle sponsored by Meridian Capital Partners. The Fund targets significant minority and control positions in high-growth, profitable-at-scale software and technology-enabled services businesses headquartered or principally operating in the United States.
MERIDIAN FUND IV MC-IV-IG-2026-07 PRIVATE & CONFIDENTIAL · SYNTHETIC / ILLUSTRATIVE DOCUMENT
The Fund targets a weighted-average holding period of 4–6 years.
Positions originated under an earlier mandate version are grandfathered under the criteria in force at original commitment.

Any investment failing one or more mandatory criteria requires written Deal Team rationale, independent Risk & Compliance review and unanimous IC approval; aggregate capital deployed under active exceptions may not exceed 15% of Total Commitments.
Northstar continues to satisfy the majority of Meridian Fund IV's mandatory thresholds after normalization.
